name: keepit-mcp-server
description: A MCP extension (MCPB) that brings Keepit's backup capabilities directly into your workspace — for both Keepit customers managing their own account and partners managing multiple customer accounts through the Partner Management Console (PMC).
long_description:
**Keepit Extension**
This extension provides a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for interacting with the Keepit REST API. It supports two usage modes: individual Keepit customers managing their own account, and partners managing multiple customer accounts through the Keepit Partner Management Console (PMC).

**What's Available Now (Read-Only)**
* **View Backup Jobs**: Check status, history, and details of backup operations across all workloads
* **Browse Snapshots**: Explore available backup snapshots and their contents
* **Monitor Connectors**: View health status and configuration of backup connectors for each service
* **Partner Account Management** *(PMC)*: List and inspect all managed customer accounts
* **Partner Connector Monitoring** *(PMC)*: View critical connectors and health summaries across all customer accounts, with links to resolution guides
* **Partner Seat Usage** *(PMC)*: Track seat allocation, usage history, and limit violations across customer accounts
* **Partner Audit Logs** *(PMC)*: Review audit log activity across all managed accounts or for a specific customer

**What's Coming Later**
* **Backup Management**: Schedule and configure backup jobs
* **Restore Operations**: Perform restores with granular control over what gets restored
* **Anomaly Detection**: Get alerts on backup issues and irregularities

**Configuration**
The extension requires Keepit API credentials which can be configured through user settings.

tools.name: get_cloud_connectors
tools.description: Get a list of cloud connectors in your account

tools.name: get_connector_health
tools.description: Get the health status of a connector. You can provide either the connector GUID or the connector name (full or partial).

tools.name: get_active_jobs
tools.description: Get a list of active jobs, including their statuses and creation dates

tools.name: get_job_history
tools.description: Get a list of backup and/or restore jobs for a connector

tools.name: get_audit_log_history
tools.description: Get a list of audit log events for a specified period

tools.name: get_my_account_info
tools.description: Get comprehensive account information, including status, creation date, product assignment, and service details

tools.name: get_latest_snapshot
tools.description: Get the timestamp of the most recent completed snapshot for a connector

tools.name: get_snapshot_range
tools.description: Get a list of snapshots for a connector within a given time range

tools.name: pmc_get_my_account_info
tools.description: Get details about the current partner account, including contact information and users with access

tools.name: pmc_get_subaccount_list
tools.description: Get a list of all customer accounts managed by this partner

tools.name: pmc_get_subaccount_info
tools.description: Get details about a specific customer account, including contact information, users, and available cloud services

tools.name: pmc_get_all_critical_connectors
tools.description: List all connectors currently in a critical state across all customer accounts managed by the partner

tools.name: pmc_get_subaccount_connectors
tools.description: Get a list of cloud connectors configured for a specific managed customer account

tools.name: pmc_get_connectors_health_summary
tools.description: Get connector health status, last backup date, and failure details for all connectors of a managed customer account

tools.name: pmc_get_connector_issue_solution
tools.description: Get the current health status of a connector and, when unhealthy, an explanation of the issue and a link to a resolution guide

tools.name: pmc_get_exceeding_seat_limit
tools.description: Get all customer accounts that are currently exceeding their seat limits, including overage and grace period details

tools.name: pmc_get_seats_allocation
tools.description: Get seat allocation per connector type for the partner or a specific customer account within a date range

tools.name: pmc_get_subaccount_seat_usage_history
tools.description: Get a historical timeline of seat usage for a specific customer account within a date range

tools.name: pmc_get_audit_log_history
tools.description: Get audit log records for a date range — for a specific customer account or grouped across all managed accounts

prompts.name: backup_status
prompts.description: Check the current backup status and any recent job failures
prompts.text: Please show me the current backup status and any recent job failures. Use the get_active_jobs and get_job_history tools to provide a comprehensive overview.

prompts.name: connector_health
prompts.description: Check the health status of all backup connectors and report any issues
prompts.text: Check the health status of all my backup connectors using get_cloud_connectors and get_connector_health tools. Report any issues or anomalies found.
